summary: Biohaven Ltd. disclosed via Form 8-K on October 15, 2026 that on October 8, 2026 it entered a Collaboration and License Agreement with Ono Pharmaceutical. Ono receives exclusive rights to develop and commercialize Biohaven's MoDE pan-IgG degrader portfolio, including BHV-1300, BHV-1310 and BHV-1320, in Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and ASEAN. Biohaven receives $80 million upfront, up to $20 million on a stability milestone, and roughly 20% royalties on net sales. Biohaven retains rights for the U.S., Europe and China. This is a routine licensing/contract event, not a special-situations transaction.
